R7BJ-moose-drive-0004.name: 5.8 km SW of Nelson Forks
R7BJ-moose-drive-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 18 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 2.2 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2008 (18 years old), 120 m SE: browse.

seasonRows.cls: Spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls
Spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls

seasonRows.notes: LEH (Limited Entry Hunting): draw only, not a general open season

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 76 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.46336, -124.08653, pull off on 121 Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 260 m W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2 m, about 5 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-49, Region 7B. Season: moose spike fork, tripalm or 10 point bulls Oct 25 to Oct 26 and more rows (synopsis page 62, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BJ-moose-drive-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-49: about 1,090 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.10 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 2 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
